areasReviewed: Literal color allowlist and inert host execution boundary
Denial of service and hidden data channels

findings.evidence: The bundle omits upstream palette definitions and the upstream license text, screenshot images, and Chromium fixture implementation. The deterministic report supports format validation but does not establish those additional claims.
findings.impact: Exact upstream attribution, screenshot authenticity, and reported contrast and interaction results remain unverified. Upstream build scripts reference omitted source files, although the inert theme does not require executing them.
findings.title: Incomplete evidence for provenance and validation claims

findings.evidence: docs/adaptation.md says user screenshots are pending, while the READMEs and docs/screenshots.md say screenshots were supplied after testing.
findings.impact: Conflicting documentation makes the extent of completed application testing unclear.
findings.title: Screenshot testing status is inconsistent

aiReview.summary: The manifest contains only literal colors and shows no malicious runtime behavior. Quarantine is warranted because provenance and validation claims cannot be fully verified from the supplied bundle.

acceptedFindings: Incomplete evidence for provenance and validation claims
